targetZones.name: Upper Chest
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Clavicular head of pectoralis major; activated by incline angles (30–45°)

targetZones.name: Mid / Sternal Chest
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Sternal head of pectoralis major; flat horizontal pressing

targetZones.name: Lower Chest
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Lower sternal fibres; activated by decline angles or dips

targetZones.name: Upper Back
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Trapezius (mid/upper), rhomboids; horizontal row-dominant

targetZones.name: Lats / Mid Back
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Latissimus dorsi; vertical pull and wide-grip row dominant

targetZones.name: Lower Back / Erectors
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Erector spinae; hip-hinge dominant movements

targetZones.name: Quadriceps
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Rectus femoris + vasti; knee extension / squat dominant

targetZones.name: Hamstrings
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Biceps femoris, semimembranosus, semitendinosus; hip-hinge dominant

targetZones.name: Glutes
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Gluteus maximus/medius; hip extension and abduction

targetZones.name: Calves
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Gastrocnemius + soleus; plantar flexion

targetZones.name: Anterior Deltoid
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Front delt; shoulder flexion and internal rotation

targetZones.name: Lateral Deltoid
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Side delt; shoulder abduction — key for width

targetZones.name: Posterior Deltoid
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Rear delt; shoulder extension and external rotation

targetZones.name: Biceps
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Biceps brachii (long + short head) + brachialis; elbow flexion and supination

targetZones.name: Triceps
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Triceps brachii (long, lateral, medial head); elbow extension

targetZones.name: Forearms
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Flexors and extensors of the wrist; grip-dominant movements

targetZones.name: Upper Abs
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Upper rectus abdominis; trunk flexion movements

targetZones.name: Lower Abs
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Lower rectus abdominis; hip flexion and posterior pelvic tilt

targetZones.name: Obliques
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Internal + external obliques; rotation and lateral flexion

targetZones.name: Transverse Abdominis
targetZones.anatomicalNote: Deep stabiliser; intra-abdominal pressure and spinal stabilization
